game.name: Guitar Hero II (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Guitar Hero II is a rhythm game for Xbox 360, allowing you, equipped with a special guitar, to become the greatest rocker of all time. String together notes on your instrument, the higher the difficulty, the harder the score. More than 40 tracks await you, from Nirvana to the Stones to Guns n' Roses. The title also features a cooperative mode.
